Neverthless, it must always be observed any exposure to extreme (too high or too low temperature, direct exposure to sunlight or to atmospheric agents, ect…)  T.M.C.   15 Months  CONDITIONS FOR STORAGE   The product should be stored in a cool and dry place, protected from atmospheric products and in their original packaging  PACKAGING   The   product   will   be   received   in   the establishment in packaging of 25 kg. The following information will be reported on the outside of every packaging: name of the product, business name of the producing undertaking,   location   of   the   producing undertaking, net weight of the product, lot number or expiry date.

MAINAGROUP DI MAINARDI MATTEO  Via Aosta 1 - 24040 Ciserano (BG) Tel. +39 3513419791 Mail – info@mainagroup.it Web site: www.mainagroup.it  Rev by R.A.Q: 06-04-2021  DECLARATIONS  NON-OGM   DECLARATION   Our company doesn’t use first raw materials (including  additives   and   flavourings)   derivated   from   genetic modification, in any of his own process. Our firm always  require certifications and declarations demonstrating the  not genetically modified origin of the first raw materials from the suppliers or producers, moreover we perform an PCR analisis on raw materials and on finished products according to an analisis plan in our own HACCP   handbook.   Consequently,   the   absence   of genetically   modified   substances   is   ensured   in accordance with the reg. CE 1829/2003 e 1830/2003.  PESTICIDE/MYCOTOXIN  HEAVY METALS   The product complies with the requirement of the regulation (CE) n. 1881/2006 and of the regulation (CE) n. 396/2005.  SAFETY DATA SHEET   Within the meaning of directive 1999/45/CE and the according amendment, the product is not considered dangerous. Consequentialy, the obligation to provide the safety data sheet does not arise according to the regulation (CE) n. 1907/2006.  IRRADIATION   The product and its first raw materials are not being irradiated.  NANOTECHNOLOGIES   The product and its first raw materials are not being produced with nanotecnologies.  MOCA CERTIFICATION   The materials used for the packaging of the product comply with the regulation (CE) n. 1935/2004 and the according amendment, for all the materials and all the objects destinated to be in contact with the food.  HACCP   The product is suitable for the human consumption and  it is produced according to the italian and european laws in the field of food production (Health Authorisation n. 140/97 of the 09/10/97 released by region Lombardia Azienda USSL n. 37). Our company works according an own system of HACCP, we ensure the hygeniec safety of the products in the entire productive and the compliance of the machining according to the regulation CE 852/2004 and the following amendment.  TRACEABILITY   The company applies the traceability to the first raw materials, to the packagings, to the finished products according to the regulamentation (CE) n. 178/2002. Morover,   we   have   implemented   a   system   of identification based on the labelling with barcode to identify the selling unit drawing them in all the furniture chain.  COUNTRY OF ORIGIN   Italy
